reopen_authority.terminal_reopen_clause: a new chronology-safe model premise that is nonduplicate and does not use 2024/test outcomes

new_trigger.source_only_scan: No pressure-gradient, geostrophic, frontogenesis, baroclinic, temperature-gradient, or scalar-gradient implementation/reference was found in src/, scripts/, active-plan Python sources, or the exact planning narratives searched. Existing geometric.py computes wind-vector gradients only; physics.py uses scalar pressure only for density.
new_trigger.schema_fact: Both GFS and LDAPS prepared schemas expose surface pressure and mean-sea-level pressure summaries, while raw issued grids and geometry are already consumed by the geometric feature builder.
new_trigger.why_distinct: This preserves spatial orientation of scalar synoptic fields that unordered mean/std/min/max/quantiles discard; it is neither another NWP source, terrain/roughness/open-flow, static metadata, source averaging, wake/power curve, nor wind-vector-gradient retuning.

objective: Boundedly determine whether one exact, source-prescribed, chronology-safe oriented scalar-gradient diagnostic from supplied issued NWP is directly supported, locally executable, and genuinely nonduplicate. Research only; no model candidate may be fitted or scored in N27.

lanes.scope: Primary papers or official meteorological documentation published no later than 2026-07-05; require a literal pressure/temperature-gradient diagnostic and evidence relevant to short-range wind or wind-power errors, not generic textbook association.
Only fixed local source/schema files; no reports with model scores, data bodies, labels, 2024/test values, fits, predictions, or metrics. Establish exact operation-level duplication or novelty.

Official field/units documentation plus fixed local metadata/code only; no API/object/data-body retrieval. Determine whether one zero-choice planar/physical formula and unchanged Darwin runtime can be frozen.

admission_gates: literal supplied field and unit availability in both or one source
strict same-issuance computation and D-1 14:00 symmetry
one deterministic grid/coordinate/gradient/projection formula with no tuned scale, level, subset, or aggregation
operation-level nonduplication against current source and closed lanes
plausible target-scale effect evidence rather than generic meteorological relevance
commercial/open-source compatibility if external code is needed; external code is not preferred
selection_rule: Root may select at most one exact no-fit prerequisite candidate only if every gate is directly supported. near_match_only, generic physical plausibility, or unresolved formula choices produce NONE and restore the formal exhausted halt.
forbidden: retuning any closed terrain, source-separation, power/wake, or existing physical-proxy family
